set.body:
Objective
One place for LPS, FSL scaled-voxel, tkRAS and voxel-index conventions.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (D2). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
image; scalafim.image.space.convention; delete flips in SpatialCoordinates, ItkAffine, ItkHdf5TransformReader, TransformAssetLoader. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. FslVolumeGeometry records FSL's own affine selection (sform if code != 0, else qform, else scaling) separately from ScalaFIM's policy; x-flip iff det(FSL-selected) > 0.
2. FreeSurferVolumeGeometry: tkr->scanner = Norig * inverse(Torig); c_ras translation only as the non-oblique special case.
3. Exactly one LPS flip constant in the codebase; the four duplicates deleted.
4. Property laws toRas . fromRas = id for all conventions; FSL handedness both signs.
5. Passes the P2.03 oblique tkRAS and conflicting qform/sform oracles.

Verification
Bounded sbt batches: <module>JVM/test then <module>JS/test for touched modules; scalafimCompileAll warning-clean.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-P2.01: ToolCoordinates convention kernel with full FSL and FreeSurfer geometry
